task.title: Actioning the fraudulent renewal — Client is requesting benefits

step.cmd: Determine if, as a result of the recalculation, the established claim related to the same BPC as the fraudulent renewal application became BPNE due to a deleted fraudulent ROE:

ul.li: If no, go to step 2.
If yes, go to step 7.

step.cmd: Determine if, as a result of the recalculation due to a deleted fraudulent ROE, a disqualification or a disentitlement must be imposed from the same BPC as the fraudulent renewal application:

ul.li: If no, go to step 3.
If yes, go to step 7.

step.cmd: Determine the renewal week. Refer to Determining the effective date of a renewal or a conversion and Conversion and renewal , if necessary.
Determine if a payment issued to the third party can be replaced in SPS:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 5.
If no, go to step 7. Note

step.cmd: Refer to NWS to review any completed WI and SROC to determine if any payment replacement has been requested for the same weekperiod. Complete a Payment: INS5207 Missing warrant replacement — Form for the weeks that were paid to a third party as follows:

ul.li: SIN: Enter the client’s SIN.
HRCC: Enter the Service Canada Centre (SCC) as shown in FTS.
Requestor: Enter your 7-digit user code.
Week Code(s): Enter the w/c of the payments to be replaced.
Warrant No(s): Enter any payment reference numbers displayed on the Payment Summary (MN19) screen. Note
Amount(s): Enter any whole dollar amounts displayed on the Payment Summary (MN19) screen.
Name: Enter the client’s last and first names.
Address: Enter the client’s address.
Telephone number: Enter the client’s telephone number.

Action to take: Type “The payments were fraudulently deposited into a third party’s bank account.” If banking information was updated to the client’s information, type “Replace the payment to the client according to the direct deposit information modified in FTS on [DD-MM-YYYY].” If the client requests payment by cheque, type “Replace the payment to the client by cheque.”

step.cmd: In NWS, create an IPOC REV WI as follows:

ul.li: Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Language: Select the appropriate option.

Destination — SCC: Select the SCC of your regional IPOC:
Atlantic: 1826
Quebec: 2642
Ontario: 3056
Western Canada and Territories: 5903
End user: Select Next available user .
Issue(s): Select Payment replacement .
BPC: Enter the BPC of the claim.
Comments: Type “Payment replacement.”
Details: Copy and paste the information from the INS5207 (select the Ctrl + 1 keys to copy and Ctrl + V keys to paste).
Obtained by: Select the appropriate option.
Obtained from: Select the appropriate option.
Source details: Enter the source details.
Select Save .

step.cmd: Determine if benefits paid to the third party must be removed from the client’s file:

ul.li: If no, go to step 8.
If yes, note all w/cs and amounts. Go to step 11. Note

step.cmd: Determine if the client is requesting benefits for other weeks:

ul.li:
If yes, determine which of the following situation applies:
If, a disqualification or a disentitlement must be imposed from the same BPC as the fraudulent renewal application as a result of the recalculation due to a deleted fraudulent ROE, go to step 9.
If the established claim became BPNE due to a deleted fraudulent ROE, go to step 15.
If the 2 previous conditions do not apply, go to step 13.

If no, determine which of the following situation applies:
If, a disqualification or a disentitlement must be imposed from the same BPC as the fraudulent renewal application as a result of the recalculation due to a deleted fraudulent ROE, go to step 9.
If the established claim became BPNE due to a deleted fraudulent ROE, go to step 15.
If the 2 previous conditions do not apply, go to step 15.

step.cmd: In FTS, review the Blocked Status column under the Blocked tab and determine if the blocked claim’s CS is 1 - Updateable :

ul.li: If yes, go to step 10.
If no , note the w/cs in which a disqualification or a disentitlement must be imposed from the BPC. This information is required on the Operational Centre Memo (MM06). Go to step 13.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC to be updated from the Blocked Status column and input the appropriate corrections to establish the appropriate OP for the client. Go to step 15.
In SPS, for each payment that must be removed, determine if the payment can be cancelled :

ul.li: If no, go to step 12.
If yes, note the payment reference number, the amount (gross benefits and net amount), w/c, BT and claim type (CT). This information is required on the Operational Centre Memo (MM06). Go to step 12.

step.cmd: Determine if the client is requesting benefits for other weeks:

ul.li: If yes, note all w/cs with the appropriate paycoding (earnings, not available days, full work week [FWW], etc.) that will affect entitlement for the weeks requested. Note the appropriate renewal date, if necessary. This information is required on the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) . Go to step 13.

If yes and the established claim became BPNE due to a deleted fraudulent ROE, do not note the appropriate renewal week and do not mention to renew the claim on the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) . Go to step 13.
If no, go to step 13.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Detection: This field is prefilled according to the investigation type in NIIS.
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .
Select Update . Note

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 54 - Third party fraud .
Remarks line 1: Type “Cancel fraudulent renewal w/c [XXXX]. Unknown third party.”

Remarks lines 2–4: Type the appropriate information:
For all payments and cycling reports to be removed, type “Remove w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX]. Total amount $[XXXX]. Adjust tax file or T4E. No OP for client.” If payments have been returned or cheques were never cashed, type “Also cancel returned payments or uncashed cheques, as appropriate, for w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX].” For each payment, type “w/c [XXXX] / [T071-2 for current year or T071-8 for the previous year] / reason F / CT [XX] / gross benefits [XXXX] / federal tax [XX] / provincial tax [XX] (if necessary) / net amount [XXXX] / PRN [XXXXXXXXXXXX].”
If an OP must be established to the client because the client received payments for which they are not entitled, type “Establish OP to the client for w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX]. Client not entitled to benefits received.” Add the appropriate paycoding (disentitlement, earnings, not available days, full work week [FWW], etc).
If an MA was imposed to stop payments, type “Rescind MA [XX].”
If payments must be issued to the client , type “ Issue payments for w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], CT [XX].” If paycoding is required, type “[appropriate paycoding, e.g. FWW, non-available days, sick days].” If there is an allocation, type “M175 [type] [amount] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], [amount, if different from last week].” (add more w/cs if necessary).” If a disentitlement must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].” If a disqualification must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your name and telephone number.
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD on the client’s application and not on the fraudulent application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — fraudulent renewal.”

Details: Type “The investigator confirmed the client’s address and banking information on: [DD-MM-YYYY]. The client’s address is: [client’s address]. The client’s banking information is: [client’s banking information].” If Integrity identified fraudulent ROEs, type “Integrity confirmed that ROE [serial number] is fraudulent.” Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Create a ROD on the fraudulent renewal application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — renewal submitted by a third party.”

Details: Enter the following information:
Relevant facts: Type “An EI renewal application was filed by a third party on [DD-MM-YYYY] using the client’s identity.”
Decision/Justification: Type “This renewal application was not filed by the client and must not be included in an access to information request.”

step.cmd: To delete the fraudulent application, create a Reminder (REM) WI as follows:

ul.li: Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Delete the application.”
Due date: Enter the next business day.
Language: Select the appropriate option.
Details: Type “Fraudulent renewal application dated [DD-MM-YYYY].”
Destination — SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.

End user: Select Specific user:
Enter the name of the team leader or the designated person and select Find user .
Select Save . Note

step.cmd: In NIIS, on the Decision tab of the IC70 Report of Investigation screen, close the case as follows:

ul.li: Disentitlement: Select No .
Reason: Select Other and type “Fraudulent renewal. Third-party OP amount is $[XX].”
Overpayment: Do not check either box.
Penalty: Select No .
Warning: Select No .
Violation: Select No .
Prosecution: Select No .
Select OK .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR Integrity ERB-EI Transition WI and all other related WIs.
